lines.en: I live in a busy street near the city center.
The traffic was terrible this morning.
There is a new metro station near my house.
My neighborhood is quiet and safe at night.
I moved to the city two years ago.
The streets are always crowded on weekends.
There are many small shops in my area.
I took a taxi because the bus was late.
The city looks beautiful at night.
I want to live in a calmer place one day.
